simulation.primary_design: Resample whole pilot documents with replacement within frozen sampling-length strata at each candidate n_h.
simulation.sensitivity_design: Resample complete canonical-type contribution clusters globally at the prospectively justified type-count assumption for the same candidate.
simulation.supported_input: One additive numerator/denominator metric and one planning system per simulation input. Run separate frozen inputs for each primary overall estimate and requested single-axis stratum.
simulation.agreement_role: Pilot agreement is a separate eligibility and annotation-error input. It may be simulated as its own additive agreement proportion, but it is not silently folded into a performance denominator or a combined score.
simulation.selection_rule: Among target-blind candidates passing both document-cluster and canonical-type sensitivity targets, choose the fewest total documents; break ties by the lower justified canonical-type count and then allocation id.

planning_pilot_design_resolution.conflict: IR-127 requires observed prevalence and cluster structure from IR-147, but the current IR-121 frame selects no Wikipedia document until IR-127 freezes n_h. A training-only convenience pilot can refine the guide, agreement procedure, and burden but cannot automatically estimate the Wikipedia sampling population.
planning_pilot_design_resolution.adopted_resolution: The versioned sampling/split addendum creates a target-blind probability-sampled planning prefix after the training-only pilot and guide freeze. It remains exposed development material and is permanently excluded from the sealed test.
planning_pilot_design_resolution.alternative_resolution: Use a declared external transport prior with conservative sensitivity bounds only if comparability to the frozen Wikipedia population is justified in writing; do not call it observed project prevalence.
planning_pilot_design_resolution.prohibited_resolution: Do not estimate population prevalence or clustering from target-enriched, target-searched, convenience-selected, or rights-filtered-after-target-exposure texts.

simulation_input_contract.row_contract: Use the exact additive contribution-row contract accepted by scripts/bootstrap_evaluation.py, with unique record_id, document_id, length_stratum, canonical_type_id, positive weight, empty strata for an overall run, and nonnegative numerator/denominator contributions.
simulation_input_contract.canonical_type_count_rule: Each candidate value must be prospectively derived from the target-blind pilot's type-richness analysis for that document allocation. It is a sensitivity assumption, not a target-conditioned document-selection quota.

candidate_allocation_contract.minimum_derivation: Six is the smallest n_h that gives every 20/10/20/50 partition at least one document under the frozen floor-plus-largest-remainder rule and its tie order.
candidate_allocation_contract.population_limit: No n_h may exceed the realized rights-pass N_h recorded before target exposure.
candidate_allocation_contract.resource_limit: feasible_resource_ceiling is the maximum final-sample document count supported by observed annotation time, double annotation, QA, adjudication, retraining, and reserve; larger candidates fail before simulation.
candidate_allocation_contract.target_conditioned_sensitivity: A hypothetical target-conditioned candidate may be displayed for sensitivity but is never selection-eligible under IR-121.

claim_withhold_rule.no_feasible_allocation: If no feasible target-blind allocation meets both the document and canonical-type half-width targets within the frozen resource ceiling, withhold the affected overall or stratum claim.
claim_withhold_rule.sparse_or_undefined: If a pilot pool has fewer than two clusters in any populated resampling length stratum, fewer than two canonical types, or any simulation is undefined, do not report a precision interval.
claim_withhold_rule.no_posthoc_relaxation: Do not relax 0.05 or 0.10 after viewing simulated or observed results; narrow scope or keep the result descriptive.

current_result.claim_ceiling: Executable pre-data simulation and fail-closed input contract only; no observed estimate, final sample size, selected document, or precision claim exists.

activation_rule: Change status to ready_to_simulate only after the accepted planning-pilot addendum is activated through its required allocation record, every required observed input is non-null and hashed where applicable, candidate allocations respect N_h and the frozen split, and the institutional human-work gate permits the pilot.
